race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
race.verdict: DEFIANT DREAM took a step forward when runner-up at Nottingham last time and is weighted to go one better and gain a first success off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Fancied Angel didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a recent fifth at Wolverhampton and is next on the list with likely better to come. Last Dandelion and Past Passion appeal also and need considering in this open nursery. DEFIANT DREAM FANCIED ANGEL LAST DANDELION
